nodes.label: Coding Rule 2: Simplicity first
nodes.rationale: Minimum code that solves the problem. No speculative features. No abstractions for single-use code.

nodes.label: Coding Rule 3: Surgical changes
nodes.rationale: Touch only what is asked. Do not improve adjacent code, comments or formatting. Match existing style.

nodes.label: Coding Rule 7: Surface conflicts, do not average them
nodes.rationale: If two parts of the codebase disagree, flag the disagreement and ask which to follow.

nodes.label: Coding Rule 11: Convention beats novelty
nodes.rationale: In an established codebase, match the existing pattern even if a better one exists.

nodes.label: Coding Rule 12: Fail visibly, not silently
nodes.rationale: Surface every skipped record, rolled-back transaction, constraint violation. Never report success when something was bypassed.

nodes.label: Coding Rule 14: Investigate before you escalate
nodes.rationale: Dispatch an agent to establish validity, full extent and proposed fix BEFORE presenting a finding to Ivan. Why: raw findings force decisions on incomplete information; symptom-scoped fixes leave siblings broken (2026-08-05: three safety claims asserted from consumer code only, one false guarantee reached Ivan). Not for typos or one-line fixes. Mark verified-by-execution vs inferred. Standing request from Ivan 2026-08-05.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 1: Identity keyed on UUID
nodes.rationale: Staff/user identity keyed on auth.users.id (UUID), not email. Email is a mutable unique-indexed attribute; ledger integrity needs a stable FK. Email-change history captured via email_changed audit events. Supersedes pre-pivot rule. Locked 2026-07-08, Decisions Log Q23 item 1. Wording still says OTP/password+MFA while code sends emailed magic link only (flagged open).

nodes.label: Hard Rule 2: email_log row first, send second
nodes.rationale: Insert email_log row FIRST, send email SECOND. Reverse order risks duplicate sends on retry. See Cron + Email architecture note.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 3: requireStaff() on every staff Server Action
nodes.rationale: requireStaff() at the top of every staff Server Action, no exceptions. Next 16 rename: staff-route gate file is proxy.ts at repo root (not middleware.ts, deprecated); exported function is proxy.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 4: Service-role key only in lib/supabase/admin.ts
nodes.rationale: Service-role key only in lib/supabase/admin.ts with 'server-only' import. Never expose to the browser.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 5: RLS on every table
nodes.rationale: RLS enabled on every table. Public writes use Server Actions with service-role client inside the action; /api/* reserved for Phase 9 cron callbacks and external integration. Anon RLS policies stay as defense in depth. See Decisions Log Q11.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 6: Single main branch
nodes.rationale: Single main branch, atomic commits per logical unit. Minimum number of branches per user direction.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 7: No premature external services
nodes.rationale: Resend wired (lib/resend.ts, Stage 6); Vercel and pg_cron not (Stage 8, deferred to Oct/Nov 2026). Stub-vs-real email switch is lib/email/eventEmails.ts checking whether RESEND_API_KEY is set in .env.local; unset now so sends are console.log stubs regardless of stage. Turns false once the email branch merges (flagged open).

nodes.label: Hard Rule 8: Three-layer validation
nodes.rationale: Form -> Zod -> DB constraint for every mutation. See Security + Robustness note section 1.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 9: Three-layer auth
nodes.rationale: Middleware -> requireStaff -> RLS for every staff action. See Security + Robustness note section 4.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 10: No PII in logs
nodes.rationale: UUIDs only in logs. See Security + Robustness note section 12.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 11: Audited-mutation tables revoke direct writes at grant level
nodes.rationale: RLS is not enough because service_role has BYPASSRLS; only table-level REVOKE blocks it. Permanent append-only (credit_ledger, audit_events): revoke insert/update/delete from public, anon, authenticated, service_role. Lifecycle definer-only (practitioner_licences): revoke insert/update but may keep service_role DELETE for erasure/test teardown. Proven by negative test asserting SQLSTATE 42501 plus positive round-trip. Class of hole caught four times in Sprints 2/3. Every new audited table ships with a row in the guard matrix. Verify with has_table_privilege, never by reading the migration.

nodes.label: Pivot-era rule: Audit insert last
nodes.rationale: Any transaction writing audit_events emits the audit event as the LAST statement before commit, because the chain trigger holds pg_advisory_xact_lock until commit.

nodes.label: Pivot-era rule: Measurement vs inference
nodes.rationale: Automation acts only on deterministic measurements (rate limits, Turnstile, OTP failure counts). Inference signals produce flags for humans, never automatic action. No IP-level enforcement on authenticated routes, ever.

nodes.label: Pivot-era rule: Multi-tenancy
nodes.rationale: Every new domain table carries organisation_id plus RLS (Q20 reversed old decision 6.3 single-org).

nodes.label: Pivot-era rule: Frontend S-Organiser is open
nodes.rationale: Ivan's M2 unfreeze scope call 2026-08-01; plan docs/plans/2026-08-01-m2-frontend-unfreeze.md. Still off-limits each for own reason: practitioner compliance math (Q26, Milestone C), practitioner app/S-Attendee (post-M4), evidence locker + share-and-verify (B6, S5), multi-track scheduling (needs deliberate data-model decision). Adopting a token value without its role broke WCAG AA on every CTA.

nodes.label: Pivot-era rule: Block architecture guardrail
nodes.rationale: 2026-07-11. Every new feature/table/module must slot into the block map in docs/architecture/BLOCK-ARCHITECTURE.md (kernel K1-K3, domain blocks B1-B8, surfaces) and pass its admission checklist before any code. Non-fitting work is a flagged decision first. Kernel changes are constitutional (Decisions Log + Ivan sign-off).

nodes.label: Graph-first rule
nodes.rationale: Ivan 2026-11-07, tokens. Vault and repo each have a graphify graph; SessionStart hook injects summaries. Use /graphify query with --budget, open only the note section the graph points to. PROJECT_STATE.md is one screen (~1.2k tokens): read whole at session start. Never read whole vault notes (Decisions Log ~40k tokens). Archive of old 53k-token history: grep, never read whole. If a result is marked compressed or truncated, retrieve full text with headroom_retrieve and the marker hash before relying on it.

nodes.label: Handoff closing protocol
nodes.rationale: Ivan 2026-11-07; order and enforcement 2026-11-14. Every handoff ends with three steps in order: (1) refresh repo graph /graphify /Users/ivan/Eventar --update (eventar-graph-refresh skill); (2) update the vault note; (3) refresh vault graph /graphify /Users/ivan/Desktop/Eventar --update. Mandatory and automatic, run without asking. Last line must read exactly: Closing: repo graph done (<date>) | vault note done (<vault note path>) | vault graph done (<date>). pnpm check:handoff (also in pre-commit hook) rejects a handoff dated 2026-11-14 or later without that line. Never write done for a step that did not run. Every handoff opens with section 0 Ivan's action list: Decide, Execute, Queued for Claude, Other sessions.

nodes.label: pnpm check:handoff
nodes.rationale: Script scripts/check-handoff.mjs; rejects handoffs dated 2026-11-14 or later lacking the exact closing line. Also run by the pre-commit hook.

nodes.label: Local stack only rule
nodes.rationale: Warning: .env.local points at the Seoul production project; never read or edit it and never use Supabase MCP tools (they reach Seoul). Use local DB postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres, test env from supabase status -o env, app on :3100 via scripts/demo/dev-local.sh, migrations via supabase migration up --local. pnpm dev (:3000) is Seoul-pointed: running pnpm test:rls or tests/cpd/ against it posts permanently undeletable credit_ledger rows. Never supabase db push or db reset. Never git push without Ivan's explicit go. Other sessions share tree and DB: check ListAgents and git status, stage only own paths.

nodes.label: Deploy status: paused
nodes.rationale: Old Phase 8 workshop deploy PAUSED; needs explicit user go, never deploy by momentum. CPD deploy path is Stage 8. Live Supabase is Seoul (ap-northeast-2); canonical prod will be fresh Singapore (ap-southeast-1), still unprovisioned. Replay-from-zero precondition closed 2026-08-10 (d60b596).

nodes.label: Backtest for mutation surfaces
nodes.rationale: Execute the Server Action on :3100 and query the row back from the local DB (memory eventar-backtest-recipe). Hosted migrations are Stage 8 work needing Ivan's go via supabase db push --linked; MCP apply_migration assigns its own version and a raw psql -f can leave half-applied migrations.

nodes.label: Pivot 2026-07-03 (Q20)
nodes.rationale: Eventar pivoted from internal workshop manager to a CPD/CME/CE event + credit platform for regulated professions (HK launch, HKCP first accrediting body). Frontend freeze lifted 2026-08-01. Roadmap vocabulary is Stage 1-13 only; docs/plans/STAGES.md is authority.

nodes.label: Static gates
nodes.rationale: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec eslint . && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm exec next build. Vitest count and Next route count are running invariants.

nodes.label: tests/rls/audited_table_writes.rls.test.ts
nodes.rationale: Standing guard matrix for audited-table direct-write revocation (Hard Rule 11); every audited table ships with a row.

nodes.label: docs/architecture/BLOCK-ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.rationale: Block map K1-K3 / B1-B8 / surfaces with new-work admission checklist.
